fields.claim: 14 CFR 101.13 limits moored balloons to 152.4 m above the surface, below the 500 m design point; 101.19 requires a rapid-deflation device, which for a vacuum hull is a rapid air valve that lands it heavy.
fields.needed_to_ground: A regulatory route for a 500 m moored or free vacuum hull.
